responsibility: Implements GCC’s scalar-evolution analysis for loops. It follows SSA definitions through assignments and loop PHIs to derive CHREC-based evolution functions, answers loop-iteration and exit-count queries, manages the SCEV cache lifecycle, classifies induction and expensive expressions, computes inner-loop effects and parameter instantiation, and performs final-value replacement of loop-exit PHIs when exact iteration counts allow, forming the main reasoning engine behind many loop optimizations.
same_name_distinction: Implements scalar-evolution analysis and transformations, including deriving CHREC evolutions, answering loop-iteration queries, caching analysis state, and doing final-value replacement. Unlike gcc/tree-scalar-evolution.h, which only declares the public SCEV API and a few inline helpers, this file is the analysis engine.
